title.narrative: Conflict Justice and Reconciliation Approaches for Durable Peacemaking

description.narrative: The Conflict Justice and Reconciliation programme seeks to enhance the prospect that peace settlements succeed by identifying key rights-based issues which are a priority for important segments of the population and tailors ways for peacemaking efforts to address them promptly. It mobilises human rights and conflict resolution expertise to engage with a broad range of stakeholders, from local communities to Track 1 actors. The programme focusses on Syria, Iraq and Yemen. In addition, the programme includes a scoping component for opportunities in relation to countries and conflict contexts which are not included in the core proposal.
